name: ocpp-virtual-charger
description: An OCPP 1.6J charge point simulator for the browser or Node.js, no dependencies: several connectors, Smart Charging profiles, cars, and a whole charging site behind one grid connection, and a garage drawn to scale with cables, phases and voltage drop.
author: Javier Ojanguren <info@askacharge.com> (https://askacharge.com)
